import asyncio
import anyio
from asyncio import TaskGroup
from anyio import create_task_group


async def joins(items, operation, session, statuses):
    for item in items:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        async with asyncio.timeout(10), asyncio.TaskGroup() as group:
            group.create_task(operation(item))
    for item in items:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        async with asyncio.timeout(10):
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            async with TaskGroup() as group:
                group.create_task(operation(item))
    for item in items:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        async with anyio.create_task_group() as group:
            group.start_soon(operation, item)
    for item in items:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        async with create_task_group() as group:
            group.start_soon(operation, item)
    for item in items:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        async with session.get(item) as response:
            statuses.append(response.status)
    while items:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        async with session.lock():
            statuses.append(len(items))
